task: Target-aware three-class financial-news sentiment and positive/not-positive decision
split_protocol: near-duplicate grouped train/validation/test; final sparse fit uses train+validation only
selection_reason: Near-best macro-F1 with stronger negative recall and the best probability calibration.

deployment.recommended_runtime: Cloud Run with at least 2 GiB memory; CPU is supported
deployment.network_note: Bake/download ProsusAI/finbert during image build for deterministic startup.

limitations: Sentiment is an estimate, not investment advice.
Entity-specific inference should provide the selected company as target.
FinBERT increases memory, image size and cold-start latency compared with the sparse model.
Monitor source-specific errors, probability calibration and vocabulary drift.
